notes: Policy form is 米国ドル建積立利率更改型一時払終身保険（保障選択型）. 積立利率 is fixed until the next 積立利率計算基準日 (20 years for contract age 15-79, 15 years for 80-90), then reset; age at the reset date 91+ gets a company-set rate (not published). The 20/15 split is by age at contract date, so term_years and age_band are tied: 15-79 with 20, 80-90 with 15.

One rate page serves every edition (all editions listed on the rate page share it). The page is 基本型 (シンプルプラン) and 連生保障型 (リレープラン); both showed identical figures in every table read (textContent compared), so one series per metric and plan is stored, not one per type. 「まごころつながる終身保険2（シンプルプラン）」 and 「PGF終身保険」 are 基本型 only; 「基本・連生選択型終身」 has no withdrawal rider.

plan base = 積立金の引出機能に関する特則を付加しない場合 (no withdrawal rider); there 実質的な利回り equals 積立利率. plan withdrawal = 特則付加 (offered since 2023-02-01); 実質的な利回り assumes the 引出 option is chosen and is lower than 積立利率. 積立利率 is the same in both plans and is stored under both.

Rates are set twice a month (contract dates 1st-15th and 16th-end); effective_date is the first day of the period. The rate page shows the current period and the 過去の積立利率 page the 48 periods from 2024-12-01; nothing earlier is published on the site. Rates before 2024-12 may exist on the old 諸利率 PDF (https://www.pgf-life.co.jp/st/products/pdf/jswl.pdf; Wayback has one capture, 2024-02-22) but the Wayback Machine answered 429/timeouts on 2026-11-17 so it was not read. It is open for a later run.
has_mva is null: not established (米ドル建 surrender value rules not read; brochure PDFs are behind a pop-up and were not downloaded).

The page notes the renaming dates: 米国ドル建保障選択型終身保険Neo until 2022-07-31, 保障選択型終身保険Neo＜米ドル建＞ from 2022-08-01; まごころつながる終身保険2 from 2023-02-01 (before that まごころつながる終身保険＜米ドル建＞); PGF終身保険＜米ドル建・一時払＞ from 2023-04-03 (before that PGFリレー終身保険＜米ドル建＞). The past-rates page also lists the predecessor 米国ドル建積立利率更改型一時払終身保険PGF (jswl_old/gib), basic type only, no withdrawal rider.

Cost shown on the page: 保険関係費用 1.30% deducted when setting 積立利率 (contract age under 91); 積立利率 floor 0.01%; cap = US Treasury yield average + 2.0% less costs. Rate setting: reference index yield average +/- up to 1.5%.

Rate fragments (/hpcms/Fxrate1100.do etc.) refuse scripts (bot protection), so the tables were read in the built-in browser pane on 2026-11-17 and saved under sources/pgf/pages/ (jswl_fxrate100, jswl_tumitate_past). The saved files are the rendered tables, not the raw server HTML. scripts/pgf.py parses them and does not attempt to bypass the protection.
Product-page documents (契約概要/注意喚起情報, Web約款) sit behind a PDF pop-up and were not downloaded or listed with URLs.

Checked 2026-11-17 by an independent agent: all 384 rate points match the snapshots, and the 過去の積立利率 tables (基本型 and 連生保障型, both plans) were re-read live in the browser pane and are identical to the snapshot. Japanese names are spelled as on the rate page (full-width Ｎｅｏ, ２, ＵＳ２, ＰＧＦ). The edition list, renaming dates and cost notes are saved as page text in sources/pgf/pages/pagetext_jswl_fxrate100_2026-11-17.txt.
Plan names shortened 2026-11-17: both plans cover the 基本型 and 連生保障型, whose rates are identical.

Launch date: 2021-12-01, from PGF's release on Kyodo PRWire calling 「米国ドル建保障選択型終身保険Ｎｅｏ」 a 新商品 on sale 「12月1日（水）より、株式会社三菱ＵＦＪ銀行」 (year from the release date; other distributors may have started later). Retrieved 2026-11-17.
notes_en: Rate history starts on 1 December 2024 and covers 48 half-month periods; the insurer publishes nothing earlier.
Rates are USD only, fixed for 20 years (contract ages 15 to 79) or 15 years (ages 80 to 90) and then reset.
Basic and joint-life types, and several editions sold under other names, share the same rates.
The with-withdrawal-rider plan has a lower yield than the crediting rate, which is the same in both plans.
Launched 1 December 2021 at MUFG Bank (insurer's release); an earlier rate table exists but could not be read. Whether a market value adjustment applies is unconfirmed.

verification.method: A reproducible random sample (scripts/recheck_candidates_b.py, seed recheck-sample:pgf-hosho-sentaku-neo-usd; every metric/plan/currency group, at least 10% per metric/plan, at least 20 rows) plus every outlier (a value outside 0-15%, more than 3 standard deviations from its series mean, or more than 1pp from the previous point) was compared with its saved snapshot by an independent parser; all checked rows matched. A pass over every row also matched.
verification.note: Rows with a retrieved_date after verified_through have not been re-checked.
